headline: Next meeting to consider a 24 Jackson Street housing appeal and a Community Preservation funding application.
summary: This agenda lists no business items for this meeting. The upcoming-meetings page lists four items for the next meeting, including a rental housing appeals policy and the 24 Jackson Street appeal.
